To capture (more) metrics, go to the Unified Map page and add /perfLogging/true to end of the URL. Then for each new page refresh that loads or a search is performed using the search box, then a new perf metrics record entry will get added to the perf metrics table and then be reflected on this dashboard.

Be sure to wait 4 seconds or so after each query completes so that metrics are captured since the nodemap component is firing mapReady a bunch of times and this "capture" logic simply waits about 4 seconds after the last one to assume nodemap is done rendering.
